references.text: The tribe of Asher did not drive out the inhabitants of Acco, Sidon, Achlab, Achzib, Helbah, Aphek, and Rehob. Aphek and Rehob are mentioned here as cities that Asher failed to conquer, the same cities that were allotted to them.
Aphek is mentioned as a city in the land of the Canaanites that had not yet been conquered at the time of Joshua.
Aphek is listed among the cities whose kings were defeated by Israel during the conquest of the land.
Rehob is mentioned as a place reached by the spies when they explored the land of Canaan, near Lebo-Hamath.
